note: the rifleman's rifle as a prop (the game drops it as Kind drop_rifle; his folder had no sprite for it). One ROW per angle; the last row (10 degrees: it rests on its butt and its magazine, the muzzle a little up) has two COLUMNS: 0 = in the air, 1 = lying on the floor with a contact shadow. The pivot is the grip pixel (where his fist held it). "fall" starts where death frame 2 leaves it (grip_dx/dy from the rifleman's anchor, canvas px, y down; flip dx with his facing): muzzle down, the muzzle meets the floor (clang), the butt comes over, it falls flat (clang = a clatter, 2-3 steel sparks), one flat hop, rest. It never stands upright and never sticks in the floor.
